Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We need to schedule a combined SOC 2 walkthrough (high level evidence review), a short DPA clause walkthrough, and to confirm a 2-week pen-test window with our vendor. Ideally we’d do the live walkthrough in an evening slot (ET) so our engineering and security folks can attend without impacting customer hours.

Option A: Thu 2028-04-12 19:00–20:00 ET (live walkthrough + short DPA Q&A)
Option B: Mon 2028-04-16 20:30–21:30 ET (if you need extra overlap for EMEA participants)

Agenda (30–45 min core + buffer):
- Introductions & scope (5 min)
- SOC 2 evidence mapping: what we’ll show and hand back (20 min)
- DPA clause clarifications (10 min)
- Pen-test scoping with vendor (10 min)

What I need from you before the call:
- Confirm preferred option
- Pen vendor primary contact (we’ll invite them live)
- Any special evidence requests (e.g., retention window, logs, audit trail slices) — if you send a short list we’ll attach a checklist to the invite

Looping in Mina (security) and Olga (platform ops) who will join the call and help with evidence handoff and the ops bridge.

If either option is tight, we can do a compressed 45-minute slot and follow up with a staged evidence handback.

—
